title: Salary negotiation
summary: Negotiate your offer with a friendly but firm recruiter.
goal: Raise my offer closer to market, through base salary or a sign on bonus.
scenario: You have an offer of 120,000 dollars base. Market data for the role says about 135,000. You're in the final round with one other company.

attendees.name: Jess
likely_objections: There isn't much room left in the base
We need an answer by Friday
Is the other offer in writing?
attendees.knows: The band tops out at 132,000 base. She can add up to 15,000 sign on and 10 percent more equity with one approval. She cannot change the level. The hiring manager really wants this candidate.

hidden_concerns: Competing offers and whether they are real
success: The offer improves or Jess commits to a concrete change, and you stay above your walk away point.
tips: Say you're excited, then name a specific number and why.
Ask about every lever: base, sign on, equity and start date.
Don't accept or reject on the call; agree when you'll answer.

key_facts.label: Other process
key_facts.value: Final round with one other company

walk_away: 125,000 base, or 120,000 base with a sign on bonus of at least 15,000.
